decision_rule: DESIGN §W7 step 7 (stats O4), implemented with the reviewed shortlist harness: both candidates are gated vs G* (§8, CI lower bound > 0, L_prob, all genes, U, no stratum); among eligible candidates the paired one-SE rule (§9) picks the first in spec order, simplest first: W7:B6 (= idea W7-01, H-b, the B6 ablation, the runner-up) before W7:W7-05 (promoted idea). P2 = W7:W7-05 only if its Δ̄_lin exceeds W7:B6's by more than the paired bootstrap SE; otherwise P2 = W7:B6. Scalars only.
notes: Second W7 look (W7 sub-cap 2/20), needed because W7_shortlist_1 (92b43d6) compared W7-05 with G* only, while §W7 step 7 requires the comparison with the runner-up. Same scores file, methods, labels, genesets, B and seed as W7_shortlist_1; only look_id, candidates and the rule text differ. Decided by the PI before this look (tree D12/D13). The runner-up is B6 = W7-01, the current best at the start of the loop; no other W7 idea passed TG. W7 auto-research loop (DESIGN §W7; A12a time box 4 h, hybrids with gene priors). Candidate W7:W7-05 = B6 (features and M2 hyperparameters unchanged) with a monotone-increasing constraint on the gene-prior features b2 and b2m; HistGradientBoosting fitted on ALL training lines (labels.train(), L_prob; b2/b2m stacked leave-own-lineage-out on fitting rows, as B6 at M2) with SEEDS[0:3]; the look score is the mean of the three seeds' predicted probabilities on the 198 validation expression lines (label-free features; priors from training lines only; every fit asserted training-only). Training (nested 12-fold LOLO, 686 lines, 12 lineages, seed-mean per-line tAP): tAP_lin 0.9029 vs B6 0.8886, delta +0.0144 [0.0133, 0.0154], 12/12 folds, TG pass against the current best (B6, stronger than P1 = 0.3529 on training); vs B2 +0.0028 [0.0022, 0.0034], 12/12. Methods: H1, H2 (generic, equal to W1), M6:H1+Bloo/M2(f=1) (= P1, descriptive), W7:B6 (B6 refit on all training lines, SEEDS[0:3] mean; descriptive). The harness requires reference = G* = H1; the C5 contrast P2 - B6 belongs to T2.
